last.minutes: We have decided to maintain our core spot positions in BTC and SOL while keeping the futures book flat. The market regime remains neutral despite greed sentiment, and chasing short-term momentum in assets like RENDER risks costly tax and fee drag. Preserving our cash buffer protects the portfolio from unnecessary churn while we wait for a clearer directional trend to emerge.

futures.why: Remaining flat to avoid capital erosion from funding fees and high transaction costs during a neutral market regime.

spot.why: Core store of value holding firm above key support levels during neutral consolidation.
Strong layer-1 ecosystem with positive institutional news and settlement speed developments.

lessons.text: Holding core spot assets with active stop-losses while keeping futures flat during neutral consolidation prevents capital erosion from churn and funding costs.
During neutral market consolidation, preserving cash and holding core assets with tight stops is superior to chasing short-term momentum which often results in costly tax and fee drag.
